raw_summary: Tesla holds 59% U.S. EV market share. BYD sold 2.26M EVs in 2025 (+28%) vs Tesla 1.64M (-9%). Tesla reclaimed global EV sales crown from BYD in Q1 2026. BYD expanding to EU with plants in Hungary/Thailand/Brazil, targeting 1.3M overseas shipments in 2026. Rivian partnering with Uber ($1.25B) and scaling R2/R3 SUV production. Ford/GM scaling back EV ambitions.
